sources.title: Human History Map research coverage registry
sources.note: Missing-card status, two border snapshots, and unreviewed identity, chronology, and border fields.

sources.title: Some phantom dynasties of early and medieval India
sources.note: Epigraphic critique identifying 766 as the latest secure Maitraka royal date and warning against invented continuity.

sources.title: Archaeology of Gujarat
sources.note: Government academy study of Valabhi archaeology, Maitraka chronology, copper plates, sites, and material remains.

sources.title: Buddhist Monuments by Debala Mitra
sources.note: Authoritative archaeological monograph on Valabhi monasteries, grants, tablets, endowments, medicine, and surviving remains.

sources.title: Buddhist Endowments by Saiva Kings under the Maitrakas of Valabhi
sources.note: Peer-reviewed charter study quantifying Maitraka beneficiaries and examining donors, monasteries, wells, and gardens.

sources.title: The Land System in Ancient India
sources.note: Official digitization discussing Maliya plates, named plots, cultivators, crops, stepwells, and land rights.

sources.title: Comparative Economies, 700 to 1500 CE
sources.note: IGNOU teaching edition on agrarian taxes, grain shares, tolls, labor obligations, and regional economic structures.

sources.title: District Census Handbook, Bhavnagar
sources.note: Official district history summarizing Vallabhi decline and the later evidentiary gap around the old capital.

sources.title: The Temples of Gujarat
sources.note: Archaeological Survey architectural corpus documenting regional shrines and the limits of stylistic dating.

sources.title: Genesis and Development of Maru-Gurjara Temple Architecture
sources.note: Scholarly architectural history of post-Maitraka local dynasties, Mularaja, merchants, ministers, and religious patronage.

sources.title: The Saga of Indian Sculpture
sources.note: Archaeological Survey synthesis placing Maitraka decline near 770 and tracing later western Indian traditions.

sources.title: Indian Temple Sculpture
sources.note: Official art-historical survey of Gurjara-Pratihara power and western Indian architectural production after 800.

sources.title: Historical and Literary Inscriptions: Radhanpur plates
sources.note: Scholarly inscription corpus reproducing the primary record, Sanskrit text, date, language, script, and 808 grant context.

sources.title: Corpus Inscriptionum Indicarum transcription collection
sources.note: Official transcription source cross-checking the Radhanpur Sanskrit wording used for the writing sample.

sources.title: Rashtrakutas and Their Times
sources.note: Authoritative monograph reconstructing Rashtrakuta Gujarat from grants at Radhanpur, Baroda, Surat, Sanjan, and Cambay.

sources.title: History of the Paramara Dynasty
sources.note: Scholarly synthesis citing the 812 Baroda charter and Karkaraja role in Gujarat frontier politics.

sources.title: The Harsola Grants of Siyaka
sources.note: Scholarly edition and translation of two 949 copper grants naming villages, officers, grantees, and dues.

sources.title: Arama and public works in Indian inscriptions
sources.note: Official epigraphic study quoting the 930 Cambay charter list of shelters, waterworks, gardens, and temples.

sources.title: History of Dharmasastra
sources.note: Authoritative reference discussing the 930 Cambay plates and royal gift rituals in their documentary setting.

sources.title: Some notes on the palaces of the imperial Gurjara-Pratiharas
sources.note: Peer-reviewed contextual study of Gurjara-Pratihara political scale, grants, monuments, and courtly representation.
